methods.anomaly: value minus the mean of the same calendar month over all usable years of the same series; no gap filling
methods.ols: least-squares slope of monthly anomalies on time; standard error, t-test p and confidence interval use the effective sample size n(1-r1)/(1+r1) from the lag-1 autocorrelation of residuals (Santer et al. 2000); *_uncorrected fields assume independence
methods.mk_hamed_rao: Mann-Kendall with Hamed-Rao (1998) variance correction for autocorrelation, on anomalies; p is null when the corrected variance is not positive
methods.mk_seasonal: Seasonal Mann-Kendall (period 12) on the monthly values
methods.sen: Theil-Sen slope of anomalies with its confidence interval (assumes independence)
methods.fdr: Benjamini-Hochberg across all analyzed series of this run, separately for each test; p_fdr is the adjusted p value

cleaning.note: Months flagged missing, partial_month or low_coverage are not used; nothing is gap-filled for the trend tests. outlier_suspect and known_discontinuity months are used and only marked. A month can carry more than one flag. Flags and known issues do not change any value or test.

gldas_tair_step_2011_05.summary_en: Step of about +0.4 K in the global land mean against MERRA-2 (GLDAS minus MERRA-2, 6 months before and after: +0.43 K); the month matches the NCEP GSI/GFS upgrade of 2011-05-09.

gldas_tair_step_2017_07.summary_en: Step of about +0.6 K in the global land mean against MERRA-2 (+0.62 K); the month matches the NEMS GFS upgrade of 2017-07-19.

gldas_tair_step_2019_06.summary_en: Step of about -0.6 K in the global land mean against MERRA-2 (-0.66 K); the month matches the FV3-based GFS v15.1 of 2019-06-12.

gldas_evap_step_2024_07_2025_06.summary_en: From 2024-07 to 2025-06 GLDAS evapotranspiration is higher than FLDAS (about +0.08 to +0.20 mm/day through 2025-05, +0.04 in 2025-06), in the same months in which the GLDAS shortwave forcing is 15 to 32 W m-2 higher than FLDAS.

gldas_soilmoist_vs_fldas_sign.summary_en: The 2001-2026 global land trend has the opposite sign in GLDAS (-0.43) and FLDAS (+0.16 kg m-2 per decade); the two series correlate at 0.08. With one comparison product it cannot be told which is closer to the truth. No clear step was found.

fdr_family.note_en: The world subset is its own Benjamini-Hochberg family: p_fdr is adjusted across the series of this file only, separately for each test. It is separate from the core snapshot (data/analysis/trends.json) and from data/extended/analysis, so the same series has a different p_fdr there; p, slopes and intervals are the same.
